Visitor customizes definition list items

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { convert } from "@xberg-io/html-to-markdown";
function main() {
  const _testVisitor = {
    visitDefinitionTerm(ctx: unknown, text: unknown): string | { custom: string } {
        return { custom: `**${text}**` };
    },

    }

  const result = convert("<dl><dt>HTML</dt><dd>HyperText Markup Language</dd><dt>CSS</dt><dd>Cascading Style Sheets</dd></dl>", { visitor: _testVisitor as never });
  console.log(result.content);
}

void main();
```
